chronology.notes: This is a 14C chronology that has been reverse calibrated from calendar years (based on laminations). Note the 4000 year jump at 20ky when the 14C calibration ends and the chronology reverts back to the lamination (calendar) ages.
Linear age model. Based on IntCal09 calibration curve. Judy Allen says this is the chronology made by Zolitschka & Negendank (1996).
This chronology is in calendar years and uses the laminated dates.
